name: atlas-brain
description: Atlas brain sidecar — the chat/AI orchestrator (memory recall, tool loop, streaming) served over local HTTP, replacing the chat + chat-with-memory edge functions. Re-imports the runtime-neutral _shared/orchestrator.ts. Tauri sidecar in packaged builds; standalone in dev.

scripts.dev: bun run fetch-models && bun run src/index.ts
scripts.compile: bun run fetch-models && bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --outfile dist/atlas-brain
